selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the name of the Third Truth in this passage?
questions.answer: The Truth of Disposing and Administering.

questions.question: Before speaking about spring, what does the passage say about the whole world?
questions.answer: It is managed like a perfect kingdom.

questions.question: What does the passage say these different things do with each other?
questions.answer: They help each other and are managed together.

questions.question: What makes his work so hard?
questions.answer: He has to care for four hundred thousand different groups.

questions.question: In the example, how many different groups are in the army?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand.

questions.question: What does the unseen hand do every spring?
questions.answer: It creates and runs a great army of living kinds.

questions.question: In the real world, what does the unseen hand make every spring?
questions.answer: A great army of four hundred thousand kinds of living things.

questions.question: What happens again in spring?
questions.answer: Many forms of life return.

questions.question: What are the other three parts of the tree named?
questions.answer: The tree itself, its flowers, and its fruits.

questions.question: What is death called for them in this picture?
questions.answer: Going on leave.

questions.question: What main idea is taught in the Third Truth?
questions.answer: Allah manages the world with perfect order.

questions.question: Is this rule described as weak or mighty?
questions.answer: Mighty.

questions.question: Which smaller things are named with them?
questions.answer: The creatures living on earth.

questions.question: How are the creatures of earth described in a humble way?
questions.answer: As weak and needy.

questions.question: Why does the passage use a commander and army example?
questions.answer: To help us understand the huge and careful management.

questions.question: What is special about the army groups?
questions.answer: They are many and all different.

questions.question: Name two more things each group receives in the example.
questions.answer: Instructions and pay.

questions.question: What does this say about the one doing the work?
questions.answer: He has amazing power.

questions.question: What real event in nature matches this army picture?
questions.answer: The coming of living species in spring.

questions.question: What does autumn do to many of these species?
questions.answer: It sends them away from their work.

questions.question: What is being proved by the orderly running of the world in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s unity and oneness.

questions.question: What does the passage say is complete in this administration?
questions.answer: Order and balance.

questions.question: What kinds of things are ruled with this order?
questions.answer: The heavens, the elements, and living things on earth.

questions.question: What gentle lesson is given about the earth’s creatures?
questions.answer: Even weak creatures are cared for.
